plan.summary:
This group has only one new charge to add: T0025's track mat pick-up at $103.30. TM01's track mat transport both ways and T0025's delivery are already charged on Coates contract lines. All 12 water barrier delivery and pick-up legs (WB01-WB06, 257 barriers) and their install and demob labour need Andrew's word, because no 2026 figure exists anywhere.

**Water barriers (WB01-WB06)**
- **TL2 is the card's Armorzone line.** Every line on contract 9972648 reads 'Armorzone MASH TL2' at Rate 1 $1.18, which is the card's 'Armorzone (per barrier)' daily rate of $1.179453. The page says Armorzone is a different product; that is wrong.
- **The card gives no figure for transport or labour.** Transport!A67 'Armorzone (30 units)' is POA for Gold Coast, both cost and charge. Armorzone labour (B90) is POA too.
- **Nothing is charged on the contracts or dockets.** Contract 9972648 has no transport or labour line. Every barrier docket on the Delivery Dockets sheet shows Charged $0; the track mat docket shows $103.30.
- **The page's hold is right in outcome.** Only its reason text should name the card's Armorzone POA line instead.
- **Recommendation (Andrew decides).** Best fix: ask STPS (Brenden Meek) to price Armorzone transport and labour on 9972648. Until then, follow last year:
  - 2025 contract 9773725 line 77, 'Transport Charge and Install - Water filled barriers', charged $17,800 for 312 barriers. That is $57.05 a barrier for the whole cycle.
  - With the card's own 3% uplift on Armorzone that becomes $58.76, or $29.38 a barrier on each leg. The delivery leg carries install and the pick-up leg carries removal, so labour gets no separate charge.
  - That comes to $7,551.03 each way, $15,102.06 in all. Without the uplift it is $14,662.18.
  - Alternative floor is what Coates pays the carriers (schedule): WB01 and WB02 SFL $290+, WB03 Teams $800+. WB04-WB06 have no carrier figure.
- **Who does the work.** iEDM's programme TP02-26003-03 says Coates installs and removes with its forklift and labour. The City of Gold Coast does the water-truck fill, so filling is not ours to charge.
- **Loads, if a per-load price comes back.**
  - Dockets: 8 deliveries — WB01 26071354, WB02 26081435, WB03 26079322, WB04 26129861, WB05 26129840, and WB06 26126575, 26126597 and 26126606.
  - At the card's 30 units a load: 12 loads each way (1, 2, 1, 1, 1 and 6).
- **Things others should know:**
  - WB19 and WB20 put back barriers already on site. Neither gets its own delivery leg, and WB02 and WB03 each get only one external pick-up. WB03's pick-up is booked for 29 Oct.
  - The record says WB04 14 and WB05 13. Baseplan (5) and the programme say 13 and 12, and Baseplan (5) has swapped the two references across lines 4 and 5.
  - WB06 is still not ticked Complete.

**Track mats**
- **T0025 delivery: already covered.** Contract 9973079 line 2 charges $103.30. The page counts it in revenue and has it bound to T0025.
- **T0025 pick-up: charge $103.30, one load.** That is the branch's own price for this same load on 9973079, and the card's transport rates are each way. When the branch raises its pick-up line, bind it and drop the recorded charge so it isn't counted twice.
- **TM01 delivery and pick-up: already covered.** Contract 9992300 line 11 is 2 × $176.97 = $353.94, booked to freight.
  - The page already counts it in revenue: it is part of the $7,817.04 contract transport and the $115,667.04 delivery figure.
  - It is not bound to TM01, so both legs still show 'POA'. Adding a card charge there would double count; the page needs a binding.
- **TM01 record fix:** its charge line holds quantity 1, but 10 mats were supplied. Labour already charges 10.
- **Labour:** install and demob on both track mat references are already priced and ticked. Steps, levelling, cleaning and fire extinguisher don't apply to mats or barriers.

**Flag for whoever owns hire:** the page reads track mat hire (9992300 line 6 at $4.83 × 10, and 9973079 line 1 at $5 × 20) as a one-off charge for the whole event. The card prices track mat by the day with a 7-day minimum, so these may be undercharged.
